# TerrasseaHUB — Full Reference

> Europe's first B2B marketplace for outdoor hospitality furniture (CHR).

Operated by **Pros Import EURL**, Paris, France. Founded in 2025 by Adrien Laniez.
Contact: contact@terrassea.com

---

## What is TerrasseaHUB?

TerrasseaHUB is a B2B sourcing platform that connects hospitality professionals (hotels, restaurants, beach clubs, cafés) with verified European manufacturers and distributors of outdoor furniture. The platform anonymises supplier identities until a quote is accepted, ensuring unbiased comparison and fair pricing.

The platform is designed for the CHR sector (Cafés, Hotels, Restaurants) and covers the entire sourcing workflow: product discovery, comparison, quoting, supplier selection, and payment via Stripe Connect.

---

## Product Categories

### Chairs
- Dining chairs, armchairs, stacking chairs, folding chairs
- Materials: aluminium, teak, resin wicker, steel, recycled plastic, Batyline mesh

### Tables
- Dining tables, bar tables, coffee tables, folding tables
- Materials: aluminium, teak, HPL compact laminate, steel, marble, ceramic

### Parasols
- Centre-pole parasols, cantilever/offset parasols, wall-mounted parasols
- Materials: aluminium frame, steel frame, acrylic fabric, Sunbrella fabric

### Sun Loungers
- Stackable loungers, wheeled loungers, double loungers
- Materials: aluminium, teak, resin wicker, Batyline mesh, Textilene

### Sofas
- Modular outdoor sofas, loveseats, corner sofa sets
- Materials: aluminium frame, resin wicker, teak, outdoor fabric cushions

### Bar Stools
- Counter-height stools, bar-height stools
- Materials: aluminium, steel, teak, resin wicker

### Accessories
- Cushions, protective covers, planters, outdoor lighting, patio heaters, windbreakers

## Buyer Flow (Hospitality Professionals)

The buying process on TerrasseaHUB works as follows:

1. **Browse & Search** — Explore the product catalogue by category, material, style, or keyword. Multilingual search is supported across 6 languages.
2. **Compare Products** — Add up to 3 products to a side-by-side comparison view to evaluate specifications, materials, and pricing.
3. **Build a Project** — Use the Project Builder wizard to define your terrace layout, seating needs, and style preferences. The engine generates recommended product concepts with a bill of materials.
4. **Request Quotes** — Add products to your sourcing cart and request quotes from multiple suppliers simultaneously. Supplier identities remain anonymous during this phase.
5. **Select Supplier** — Review quotes, compare pricing and lead times, and select the winning supplier for each product.
6. **Payment & Delivery** — Payments are processed securely via Stripe Connect. The supplier ships directly to your venue.

**Cost for buyers:** Completely free. No subscription, no platform fee, no obligation.

---

## Supplier Flow (Manufacturers & Distributors)

The supplier onboarding and selling process:

1. **Register** — Visit https://terrassea.com/become-partner and create a supplier account.
2. **Choose a Plan** — Select a subscription plan (Starter is free) that fits your business.
3. **Upload Catalogue** — Add products manually, via CSV import, or through API integration. Include photos, specifications, pricing, and stock levels.
4. **Receive Leads** — Get notified when buyers request quotes for products in your catalogue.
5. **Submit Quotes** — Respond to quote requests with your pricing, lead times, and conditions.
6. **Win Orders** — When a buyer selects your offer, the order is confirmed and payment is processed via Stripe Connect.
7. **Ship & Get Paid** — Ship directly to the buyer's venue. Payment is released automatically after delivery confirmation.

---

## Subscription Plans (Suppliers)

### Catalogue Plans

| Plan | Monthly Price | Commission per Sale | Catalogue Limit |
|------|--------------|--------------------|-----------------|
| Starter | Free | 8% | 10 products |
| Growth | €249/month | 5% | 100 products |
| Elite | €499/month | 3.5% | Unlimited |

### Brand Plans

| Plan | Monthly Price | Commission | Features |
|------|--------------|------------|----------|
| Brand Member | €790/month | 0% | Branded page, priority placement, unlimited catalogue |
| Brand Network | €1,290/month | 0% | Everything in Brand Member + multi-brand network, dedicated account manager |

### What's Included in Every Plan

- Access to qualified B2B leads from the hospitality sector
- Product listing in the searchable catalogue
- Quote management dashboard
- Order tracking and analytics
- Multilingual product listing (auto-translated to 6 languages)

### Additional Features by Plan

- **Growth+**: CSV product import/export, newsletter referral, stock synchronisation
- **Elite+**: API integration, priority support, advanced analytics
- **Brand Member+**: Branded supplier page, SEO-optimised profile, featured placement in search
- **Brand Network+**: Multi-location support, dedicated account manager, custom reporting

---

## Platform Features

- **Multilingual Search** — Product search works across all 6 languages with automatic translation
- **Supplier Anonymity** — Supplier identities are hidden during comparison and quoting to ensure fair evaluation
- **Stripe Connect Payments** — Secure payment processing with automatic supplier payouts
- **Stock Synchronisation** — Real-time stock levels via CSV or API for Growth+ plans
- **Analytics Dashboard** — Suppliers see views, quote requests, conversion rates, and revenue metrics
- **Project Builder** — Buyers can define terrace parameters (size, style, capacity) and receive AI-generated furniture concepts with bill of materials
- **Mood Board** — Visual inspiration board to save and organise favourite products
- **Architect Programme** — Interior designers and architects can access the platform to source for their clients
- **GDPR Compliant** — Full compliance with European data protection regulations
- **Responsive Design** — Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

## FAQ

**What is TerrasseaHUB?**
TerrasseaHUB is Europe's first B2B marketplace dedicated to outdoor furniture for the hospitality industry (hotels, restaurants, cafés, beach clubs). It connects buyers with verified European manufacturers and distributors.

**How much does it cost for buyers?**
Browsing the catalogue, comparing products, and requesting quotes is completely free for buyers. There is no subscription or commitment required.

**How much does it cost for suppliers?**
Suppliers can start with a free Starter plan (8% commission) or choose Growth (€249/month, 5%), Elite (€499/month, 3.5%), Brand Member (€790/month, 0%), or Brand Network (€1,290/month, 0%).

**Which countries does TerrasseaHUB cover?**
TerrasseaHUB operates across 9 European countries: France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark, Belgium, Slovenia, Turkey, and Portugal.

**What product categories are available?**
Chairs, tables, parasols, sun loungers, sofas, bar stools, and accessories — all designed for professional outdoor hospitality use.

**Are supplier identities hidden?**
Yes. Supplier identities remain anonymous during the comparison and quoting phase, ensuring unbiased product selection based on quality and price.

**What languages are supported?**
The platform is available in 6 languages: French, English, Italian, Spanish, German, and Dutch.

**How do I become a supplier on TerrasseaHUB?**
Visit https://terrassea.com/become-partner to register and choose a plan. You can start with the free Starter plan and upgrade at any time.
